items.title: Remove direct commit path from stash split plan
items.context: The document currently says each bucket may become a future story or commit, but later requires one future story per bucket. Fix only this logical inconsistency so the execution path remains Lattice story-gated and host-neutral.

happy.desc: The purpose paragraph requires each accepted stash bucket to become a separate future Lattice story, with tests and evidence.

edge.desc: The document no longer offers a direct commit path that could bypass story-scoped checklist, review, validation, or evidence gates.

adversarial.desc: The fix does not rewrite unrelated bucket mechanics, stash commands, NAV handling, or host-neutral safety rules.

verificationEvidence.note: Purpose paragraph now requires each bucket to become a separate future Lattice story with its own tests and evidence.
The direct story-or-commit bypass wording is absent, so the execution path remains story-gated.
Diff is limited to the verified purpose paragraph correction; stash commands, NAV handling, and bucket mechanics are unchanged.

items.title: Verify stash split plan remains executable and NAV stays unchanged
items.context: Run mechanical checks for stable STASH_OBJECT, no whole-stash restore, NAV 37/37 consistency, and absence of the direct commit bypass wording.

happy.desc: Mechanical checks confirm stable STASH_OBJECT, stash inventory, and no whole-stash apply/pop/restore regressions remain valid after the wording fix.

edge.desc: NAV remains unchanged and mechanically consistent at 37 decision files and 37 NAV decision links.

adversarial.desc: Search confirms forbidden direct bypass wording such as "story or commit" is absent from the execution path while legitimate uses of commit in acceptance text remain scoped to story commits.
